entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal memory layer available as a managed cloud or Apache-2.0 self-hosted solution. It supports multi-level memory for User, Session, and Agent states through temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that organizes context as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs. It utilizes a three-tier L0/L1/L2 loading system for on-demand retrieval and supports session archiving via background memory extraction and merging.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This open-source platform provides persistent long-term memory across multiple agent sessions using a self-hosted knowledge graph engine. It builds knowledge graphs from text and code and supports automatic routing for graph, vector, and code retrieval.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This brain for Hermes Agents stores facts with provenance, allowing for corrections and memory withdrawal. It builds a knowledge graph with typed edges for entity relationships and generates synthesized answers featuring citations and gap analysis.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that maintains user profiles with stable facts and recent activity. It features a custom vector graph engine with sub-300ms recall and provides connectors for Google Drive, Notion, GitHub, and OneDrive.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: This memory system focuses on long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows. It supports over 25 LLM providers and is available via Python and Node.js SDKs or through deployment via Docker, Kubernetes, pip, or managed cloud.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: This memory library serves as the upstream component for the elkimek/honcho-self-hosted Hermes wrapper. It is implemented as a FastAPI server that provides reasoning-first memory by extracting conclusions from conversation history.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that manages a markdown context tree using Git-like version control. It features a 5-tier retrieval system with sub-100ms latency and includes an interactive TUI and REPL interface.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system that requires only one pure-Python dependency and a SQLite database. It features episodic compression for sub-linear storage growth and supports MCP, Python SDK, and native tool integrations.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system includes vector search, structured facts, and an auto-curated wiki. It utilizes a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context within a local infrastructure of Docker, Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: This recursive context harness helps agents succeed on complex tasks by executing tasks through iterations to retain lessons and artifacts. It stores immutable context bundles and outcome-gated promotion data in the filesystem.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin that uses a hierarchical DAG and SQLite store to ensure no message is lost. It provides specific recall tools, such as lcm_grep and lcm_recall, for detailed message recovery.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes existing local history from over 20 coding agents to enable millisecond lookups across months of session data. It automatically strips keys and tokens during indexing to ensure security while searching gigabytes of past session history.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend provides private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent using Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It supports any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider or local inference server for flexible, persistent memory management.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur utilizes an open engram YAML format to store memory as plain-text files for local ownership and multi-agent use. It employs a hybrid of BM25 and embedding search to provide local-first retrieval for MCP tools like Claude Code and Cursor.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first layer manages identity, memory, and secrets with 97.6% answer accuracy on LongMemEval benchmarks. It constructs memory automatically from Discord, Obsidian, and office documents, integrating directly with Hermes Agent and Claude Code.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates locally without API keys or cloud dependencies. It utilizes hybrid retrieval, including BM25 and vector search, to integrate with agents via MCP and Claude Code hooks.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This five-package plugin family provides durable, file-based memory using a hierarchical SQLite schema and FTS5 search. It functions without vector databases or embedding models, supporting Linux, macOS, and Windows environments.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This project optimizes context through block reordering and deduplication to reduce prefill latency by 1.5–3×. It offers native plugin support for Hermes Agent to save up to 36% in token usage during inference.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This plugin provides explainable recall by tagging every retrieved result with a 'why_retrieved' marker and resolving memory contradictions. It supports an embedded in-process backend, making it suitable for serverless deployments.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: Agentcairn uses an Obsidian vault as a source of truth, storing durable memory as inspectable Markdown files. It employs a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search, ensuring memory remains daemonless and user-owned.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: This CLI serves as a machine interface for agent-driven knowledge maintenance, preserving citations and temporal memory without vector databases. It supports portable archives, allowing agents to autonomously recall and evolve knowledge across sessions.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory owner for Hermes Agent. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide agents with purpose-built evidence packets for each query.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by watching agent session logs and storing data locally via SQLite-vec. It is an MCP-native server that uses GGUF models to provide RAG and vector search capabilities.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This memory layer resolves live workspace states into verified context files to reduce prompt token usage by up to 94%. It provides local-first session history tracking and supports MCP-native integration via stdio or SSE servers.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system utilizes semantic search with BM25 full-text ranking and graph traversal to manage agent knowledge. It features automated indexing for codebases and multimedia with OCR support, using edge tags to create bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: Designed to reduce schema overhead, this tool uses local BM25 ranking to select relevant keywords for Hermes Agent v0.14.0. It includes a dedicated dashboard for tracking estimated token savings and supports native tool search functionality.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed context layer manages workflows for coding agents like Claude Code and Codex using hash-checked proposals and receipts. It facilitates reviewed context updates and provides a source-neutral migration path for chat and document exports.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin uses a single .lbdb embedded graph database to store memories with a 1-10 importance ranking. It prioritizes high-value information during context prefetch using BM25 keyword search and optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin implements a pull-model that supports immediate event deletion and an on-demand summarizer. It maintains a trace.jsonl audit log to provide a transparent record of every prefetch and memory operation.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables agents to handle x402 payments using USDC and stablecoins across EVM and Solana chains. It functions as a budget-bound wallet that operates without the need for a backend, database, or API keys.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local artifacts such as scripts, cron jobs, and documentation to provide capability routing for Hermes Agent. It registers five native tools for searching and fetching artifacts while automatically generating routing notes.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables durable cross-session memory through pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. It utilizes a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox to manage tools for searching and updating agent state.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin provides self-organizing long-term memory with tools for manual storage and retrieval. It supports configurable query expansion and result reranking to optimize how the agent accesses stored information.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories, requiring a local SourceVault server for indexing and vector storage. it adds deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools for semantic search and grounded Q&A.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution offers AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and exact-text recall. It can be executed via native Rust FFI or an HTTP daemon, featuring MinHash deduplication and metadata filters.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal, utilizing a hybrid search approach that combines BM25, vector, and graph methods. It supports automatic context checkpointing during message compression to preserve information integrity.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This file-based kit manages memory hygiene through a git-backed directory of versioned markdown files rather than a traditional database. It features 'rot' and 'lint' curators to identify stale or conflicting data, allowing users to review evidence-cited diffs via five specific slash commands.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a subagent-driven development methodology designed for autonomous task execution. It enforces test-driven development and YAGNI principles while integrating as a plugin for various coding harnesses and CLIs.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first design and prototyping system that generates web, mobile, and motion graphic artifacts in formats like HTML, PDF, and MP4. It features native agent runtime support through integration with the DeepSeek Harness.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This repository provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, and NIST CSF 2.0. The library is compatible with over 26 AI platforms for standardized security operations.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill converts codebases, infrastructure-as-code, and schemas into draw.io diagrams using natural language descriptions. It supports incremental synchronization to preserve manual layouts and includes both a CLI and an optional MCP server.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Acting as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this project provides a master router and connector skills for delegated permissions and payments. It incorporates a verification and dispute resolution layer to manage natural-language mandates and escrow.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a two-pass detection system. It supports rewrite, detect-only, and edit-in-place modes with optional voice profiles for different tones.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This agentic evolver automates skill deduplication and quality improvement across sessions for Hermes and other OpenAI-compatible APIs. It includes a bilingual dashboard for inspecting session traces and monitoring collective skill evolution.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with Claude Code and agent-plugins.org specifications. It maintains session state locally within the project's documentation folder.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,169 professional and life skills distributed as plain markdown files under the MIT license. The skills are designed to run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code with ready-to-paste exports for other assistants.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This tool enables agents to perform video searches, browse channels, and extract transcripts or playlist data. It is compatible with Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, and various AI-powered IDEs, requiring a TranscriptAPI key for operation.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that automatically detects and proposes reusable skills by watching active workflows. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, allowing users to manage detected patterns via slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project teaches Hermes Agent to write its own analytical prompts and custom thinking instructions for specific tasks. It utilizes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project enables type-safe agentskills.io support for Pydantic AI with remote registry integration via Git and S3. It provides tools for reading bundled resources and executing untrusted scripts within a sandboxed environment to isolate them from the host.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This skill set transforms rough concepts into structured design documents and implementation handoffs for Hermes Agent. It features Lite and Full modes for different project complexities and includes a spec review gate that uses PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This literate programming skill allows agents to weave prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It includes a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically synchronizes edits from those files back into the original documentation.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro is a local-first, Git-based harness for long-running agents that operates without a background service. It utilizes a three-layer system of kernels, plugins, and Markdown recipes to implement the SLP protocol for supervised team coordination.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory by capturing high-value decisions and outcomes in markdown files. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning to replacement models based on recorded work history.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource provides installation guides and skills in the SKILL.md format specifically for Portuguese-speaking users. It supports the agentskills.io standard to facilitate localized Hermes Agent integrations.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Following the Agent Skills specification, this project enables agent interaction with Oracle networks and smart contracts. It supports Chainlink services including CCIP, Data Feeds, VRF, and Data Streams via the Vercel open skills ecosystem.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills provide API integration and prompting guidelines for FLUX image and video generation. The suite includes eight specialist skills for FLUX 3 video tasks and supports polling and webhooks for BFL API interactions.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into agentskills.io-compliant skills. It features automated workflows for briefing, testing, and exporting skills while linking instructions to specific file lines or URLs.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: Skilldock.io is a registry for reusable AI skills that supports recursive dependency resolution during installation. It provides a Python client and CLI, incorporating commerce features through TON payments.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika defines AI workflows as code using a YAML-based language with four verbs and a Rust binary. This local-first tool includes a CLI for checking and tracing task execution across OpenAI and Codex models.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution of complex, multi-step tasks with real-time progress and decision tracking. It includes built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures to ensure safe recovery during long-running operations.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during agent interactions. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and supports incremental discovery of server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Serving as a community hub for skill discovery and one-click installation, this project implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. it operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This project implements a five-layer retrieval system that uses hard triggers and semantic embeddings to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. By filtering skills through RRF fusion and FTS5, it reduces token usage and supports graceful degradation if dependencies are missing.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed as an ADHD-friendly execution system, this project provides agent-driven scheduling and habit tracking via an MCP connection. It stores all data in a local SQLite file and includes both a React web application and an Expo-based Android app.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only skill performs adversarial bug-hunting by deploying three parallel subagents to attack code from different angles. It combines deterministic scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings produced in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across multiple surfaces like Discord and Telegram to reduce token usage by 20–80%. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five specific dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a swarm of three sub-agents to improve code hygiene, clarity, and correctness across five programming languages. It employs a tiered application process that requires an approval gate before applying changes.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project introduces systematic investigation protocols and multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It utilizes a Python goal engine to manage persistent task states and prevent early-stop errors during debugging.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern enables tool-based skill loading via Microsoft.Extensions.AI. It supports progressive disclosure through SKILL.md files and automates the registration of common skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey laboratory equips Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks and standards to support research into CVE-driven exploits spanning from 2015 to 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: These production-tested skills provide session management and worktree recovery to maintain memory between agent conversations. The toolkit also orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and detects state drift in development environments.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability for Hermes Agent across 11 monitoring tabs, including token costs and error tracking. It enforces a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry to ensure data privacy during session and skill monitoring.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible demo GIFs for repositories using vhs or Playwright recording scripts. It handles the full pipeline of rendering, compressing files to under 8 MB, and embedding the resulting markdown into README files.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This tool generates portable agent skills from plain language and validates them against runtime-specific profiles to prevent specification drift. It monitors official frontmatter specs weekly and uses CI-friendly exit codes to report inconsistencies.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server allows agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and integrates with MCP-compatible clients like Hermes and Cursor.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic framework creates a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to identify and propose skill coverage gaps. It gates all updates behind deterministic and LLM-judge evaluators and operates locally using the Python standard library.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: These skills enable deterministic path routing and Python interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. The tool ensures environment-specific path syntax is used and verifies project-compatible runtimes without requiring new installations.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses using protocols such as Pay Link and x402. It is designed for compatibility with the agentskills.io standard and works across OpenClaw and Hermes Agent environments.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides specialized utilities for Chinese language processing, including Douyin video transcription and rule-based removal of AI writing patterns. It also features macOS-based OCR for structured data extraction and an e-commerce material studio.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This project provides a functional quality seal by testing agent skills for structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable Ed25519 certificates to confirm that a skill operates as intended.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin facilitates a decentralized support ecosystem where users earn USDC on the Base network by answering bounties over x402. It allows for listing bounties and creating boards without requiring accounts or API keys, using dedicated wallet keys for transactions.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This integration exposes 191 tools and five production-grade workflow skills through a hosted MCP server. It enables Hermes Agent to access structured web data across 31 different platforms.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates multi-scale Chinese news reports ranging from global events to street-level updates. It utilizes semantic memory to integrate user interests and applies quality gates to produce structured analysis and action suggestions.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for Hermes and other AI coding agents, offering both open-source and unfree licensed binaries. It serves as a reliable source for developers who need consistent access to the latest agent versions and development tools within the Nix ecosystem.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone provides an automated installer and configuration guides for running the Antigravity CLI and OpenClaw on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables hardware and UI access through Termux:API and Termux:GUI, allowing the agent to interact directly with smartphone features.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a Termux-based installer that utilizes proot-distro Ubuntu to run Hermes Agent on Android devices. It supports interactive model setup, shell command execution, and connectivity to both local Ollama instances and external providers.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates the deployment of Hermes Agent on Kubernetes with a focus on single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows, including configurable gateway modes with API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings Hermes to both Android and iOS platforms using Termux and iSH. It distinguishes itself by integrating with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supporting scheduled tasks via cron jobs on mobile hardware.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a high-security deployment option using NVIDIA OpenShell for hardware-enforced sandboxing. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access, governed by configurable security policies for web searches and messaging.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for operating Hermes agents on Docker or Kubernetes, featuring a catalog of 69 credentials and 17+ LLM provider integrations. It prioritizes security through AES-256-GCM encryption for secrets and mandatory encryption keys.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project offers a straightforward Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows users to build specific agent versions using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This NixOS module enables reproducible Hermes deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and settings. It supports a hybrid skill management system and integrates securely with systemd EnvironmentFiles and sops-nix for secret handling.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane designed to manage multiple agent instances with separate workspaces and RBAC-controlled access. It enables hierarchical communication and delegation between agents, alongside enterprise MCP access for external AI clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Targeting Ubuntu and Debian servers, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation. It is optimized for production environments requiring the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles its own Python environment, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in offline or isolated environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework deploys specialized agents to conduct fundamental, sentiment, news, and technical analysis for financial trading. It utilizes structured debates between bullish and bearish researchers to assess risk and supports multiple LLM providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and DeepSeek.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform governs agent registration, task dispatching, and cost tracking across multi-agent workflows. Users can manage agents via a Web UI, CLI, or MCP server, with support for local Node.js installation or Docker deployment.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code, through TUI and web dashboards. It features container-based isolation, Git worktree management, and persistent sessions via tmux for background execution.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This execution engine is the first to manage Hermes agents on the Solana blockchain using the Claude-style MCP protocol. It detects HTTP signals to handle payment-required states for paid APIs and supports scaling from single VPS agents to orchestrated teams.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a level-based architecture and a task bus pattern to scale Hermes Agent from a single instance to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for technical operations such as VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This orchestration tool enables the creation of autonomous swarms with durable memory and visual org charts for team delegation. It supports over 23 LLM providers and integrates MCP tools to expand agent capabilities.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work through a Kanban board and human-in-the-loop verification. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution to facilitate the review of task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across a strict pipeline architecture for research, planning, and infrastructure tasks. A Master Orchestrator manages the routing and coordination of these agents to ensure structured project implementation.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using Hermes Agent profiles and the MCP and ACP protocols. It features a real-time UI for monitoring agent dialogues and managing task lifecycles via a Hermes Kanban board.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-optimization framework automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies to battle for GitHub stars. It utilizes Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and learning, visualized through a real-time scoreboard and task dashboard.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack using Hermes for task routing and tool-calling on consumer GPUs. It is optimized for RTX 4080/5080 hardware and runs via Ollama to eliminate cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that reduces token usage for Hermes Agent by pre-indexing symbols and callers. It automatically synchronizes the index during file changes and includes a browser-based UI for visualizing code relationships.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI utility that tracks token consumption and costs for Hermes Agent and other AI tools by extracting data from local session logs and SQLite databases. It offers a 3D visualization dashboard to monitor usage patterns across multiple coding agents.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows developers to inspect API traffic from Hermes Agent and other CLI-based tools while redacting sensitive authentication headers. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported trace sessions to facilitate debugging and inspection.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of token usage, account limits, and costs directly from the Hermes Agent state. It supports multi-device synchronization and breaks down usage data by tool, model, session, or specific project.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers compatible with Hermes Agent and other AI providers. It helps developers build better user interfaces by integrating design-focused prompting and markdown support into the agent's workflow.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents and 36 skills to streamline building and shipping applications with Hermes Agent. It is designed for autonomous execution on both local laptops and remote VPS environments.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins provides a collection of community-driven themes and CLI skins to customize the Hermes Agent terminal interface. Users can modify banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art using simple YAML-based configurations.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This project ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel, allowing it to run natively without external processes or OAuth. It also introduces specialized MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: Tiny.place establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol and identity registration with human-readable handles. It enables Hermes Agent to participate in commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control through a supervisor sidebar that manages approvals and checkpoints. It supports external MCP clients and provides built-in integration for major AI providers and automation workflows.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory integrations for various frameworks using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It enables persistent memory across platforms including Telegram, Slack, and VS Code.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve up to 99% token savings during Hermes Agent workflows. It includes over 40 pre-configured skills for finance and devops, featuring an automated installer for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents through per-folder configurations and project-local memories. It allows users to switch between default and scoped agents while maintaining local control over specific skills and custom instructions.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: A static analysis tool that identifies ambiguities and conflicting directives within agent instructions and tool descriptions without requiring LLM or network calls. It supports CI integration through SARIF output and baseline management to ensure configuration quality.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool provides automated installation for the hermes-agent stack and 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It facilitates rapid setup with support for 29 community plugins spanning six functional categories.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: A specialized migration utility that converts OpenClaw assets, including SOUL.md and memory archives, into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It automates the setup of systemd gateway services and handles the mapping of nested authentication structures.
entries.observeco/observeco: This observability tool uses a native plugin to export real-time telemetry from agent conversations for monitoring and auto-recovery. It features zero-token passive analysis and active probing to detect performance drift relative to local file changes.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: A deterministic local runtime designed for commercial tasks that operates with zero network access by default. It enforces a security model requiring explicit approval for all external writes and consequential actions through specific contract structures.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This plugin adds offline voice capabilities to Hermes Agent, supporting wake-word activation and adaptive turn-taking across 35 languages. It functions entirely locally without the need for API keys or external accounts.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: A memory management plugin that provides tools for semantic search and multi-dimensional storage within the MemOS ecosystem. It includes a built-in circuit breaker to maintain stability during potential API outages.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built on the Tauri 2 framework, supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It serves as an all-in-one tool for managing configurations for Hermes Agent alongside other CLI tools like Claude Code and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application featuring a built-in agent engine with full file read and write access. It enables 24/7 automation via Cron and provides remote access through a WebUI and various messaging platforms.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Developed with Python and vanilla JavaScript, this interface allows users to access Hermes Agent from web browsers or mobile devices. It features a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure access through SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app facilitates the installation, configuration, and operation of Hermes Agent across multiple AI providers. It provides a dedicated GUI for managing chat sessions, tools, and guided provider setup.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard manages AI chat sessions across ten communication platforms, including Telegram, Discord, and Slack. It supports visual workflows with approval gates, scheduled jobs, and detailed usage analytics.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and specialized panels for memory browsing and MCP catalog management.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and other agents into desktop, standalone server, or Docker deployments. It includes fifteen built-in agents and offers native iOS and Android clients for remote connectivity.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts with an embedded terminal for shell access. It includes native views for managing sessions, Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first application features a built-in Hermes-CN-Core kernel with health check capabilities. The UI supports LaTeX and Markdown rendering for chat, memory management, and process control.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects browser context to Hermes runtimes via local gateways or remote APIs. It offers site-aware drafting assistance and live browser control with approval gates and tab triage features.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app for iOS 18+ that pairs with a hermes-webui server without using third-party relays. It allows users to manage agent chat, server files, skills, and scheduled tasks directly from a mobile device.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace provides one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines while offering custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking token usage and latency alongside a live workspace for monitoring code writes.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI consciousness monitor features nine tabs and four color themes for tracking agent growth and git projects. It provides a tmux operator view specifically designed for managing live agent panes and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard offers a browser-based terminal and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines. It includes an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles alongside real-time chat and tool call visualization.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that tracks live Codex and Claude quota burn and API-equivalent costs across 15 agents. It maintains local search indexing for prompts and tool calls without uploading session history or telemetry.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace provides a dedicated interface for Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts with one-click automated agent installation. It features an integrated WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It includes a specialized approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a terminal-based environment for chatting and managing agent sessions. It incorporates a kanban board for task management and supports the configuration of profiles, skills, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This React-based Telegram Mini App provides a 10-page mobile-first UI with terminal chat and file attachment support. It utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication to manage up to five concurrent background agent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop application runs without installation or admin rights using embedded Python and Node.js runtimes. It features a Tkinter GUI with granular permission controls and 100 tools for TTS, music, and ComfyUI automation.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and a task tracking dashboard for self-hosted assistants. It includes management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers alongside an integrated file browser.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A monitoring dashboard focused on session activity, cost tracking, and the inspection of skill source code. It provides read-only access to configuration and environment variables for secure process oversight.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: This chat-first workspace uses real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards to manage agent interactions. It features an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profile management for separate memory and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This desktop client facilitates orchestrated collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents through a central PM orchestrator. It includes a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports native streaming responses with model switching.
